references.text: The firstfruits of the grain were to be brought to the Lord, pointing forward to the wave offering of bread in Leviticus.
The Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest is mentioned here, corresponding to the time of the wave loaves.
On the day of the firstfruits, at the Feast of Weeks, a new grain offering was to be presented to the Lord.
The Feast of Weeks was to be celebrated with voluntary offerings that correspond to the firstfruit offering mentioned in Leviticus.
Leaven was normally forbidden in sacrifices, but it was allowed in the firstfruit offering, making the wave loaves unique.
The firstfruit offering of the grain sheaf is linked to the wave loaves that came fifty days later.
Pentecost (the Feast of Weeks), when the Holy Spirit was poured out, fulfills the symbolism of the firstfruit offering with the two wave loaves.
Christ as the firstfruits of those who have died connects to the firstfruit symbolism in the feast.
Believers are described as a firstfruit of God's creation, reflecting the firstfruit offering.
